data.name: Rainbow Forest Museum
data.description: Rainbow Forest Museum provides exhibits of petrified wood, fossils, and displays of prehistoric animals as well as information, book sales, and restrooms.
data.audioDescription: Rainbow Forest Museum provides exhibits of petrified wood, fossils, and displays of prehistoric animals as well as information, book sales, and restrooms.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: There are several dated cancellation stamps including the main one for the park, Route 66, Painted Desert, and the Painted Desert Inn. There is also a picture of a giant reptile and a junior ranger badge stamp.

data.name: Painted Desert Inn
data.description: In its almost 100 years overlooking the Painted Desert, the inn has undergone many changes. The original building from the early 1920s was made of petrified wood. Today's stucco façade dates to the 1930s renovation of the Painted Desert Inn. The national historic landmark functions only as a museum now, with no overnight accommodation and food service. Displays inside highlight the building's history, Route 66, and the Civilian Conservation Corps. There are also restored murals by Hopi artist Fred Kabotie.
